text:
Maya (Design): sketch up: https://www.figma.com/file/new/onboard-inline-detect — proposal: detect likely runtime and show a tiny, single-step card that can be run inline.
Owen (PM): goal is to let users 'get something running' in one click. nice. what about false positives?
Maya (Design): add a subtle line: 'Looks like this repo uses Node. Not right? Browse all.' keeps it reversible.
Priya (Frontend): implement detection async; show skeleton then replace with card. avoid layout shift by reserving space.
Samir (DevEx): small perf note: repo scan should only look at filenames and top-level manifests. do detection client-side for privacy.
Renee (A11y): when cards update, we must notify SR users: aria-live="polite" plus a sr-only message. also ensure the one-click action is reachable by keyboard.
Owen (PM): copy options for the card CTA: 'Run sample', 'Try this starter', 'Launch demo'. which is clearest?
Maya (Design): lean 'Get started' on the primary button and 'View alternatives' secondary.
Priya (Frontend): show estimated runtime tag: 'Quick (<5m)' or 'Setup (~10m)'. compute on heuristics; label as estimate.
Samir (DevEx): session preference: if user clicks 'Don't show suggestions', store in sessionStorage. if they opt-in to personalization, persist in profile.
Renee (A11y): checklist before merge: 1) announce replacement, 2) focus to primary CTA after update, 3) ensure contrast on runtime tag, 4) test with JAWS/VoiceOver.
Maya (Design): UI tweak: add small privacy tooltip: 'We only read filenames in your browser.' links to docs.
onboard-bot: Preview deployed for experiment/onboard-inline-detect — https://preview.redwood.ai/onboard-detect (staging)
Owen (PM): I will create a tiny analytics event for suggestion_shown and suggestion_clicked. keep events minimal.
Priya (Frontend): will prototype parser this week; can demo in staging. need a11y pairing for SR flows.
Renee (A11y): happy to pair. also flagging contrast on the pill in dark mode.
Maya (Design): thanks — will iterate on mock and push updated copy tonight.
Owen (PM): filing follow-ups: privacy wording approval, a11y preflight, metric events.
Maya (Design): closing for now, will ping when updated. :sparkles:
